# CEDEXX — 24/7 Virtual Primary Care & Telehealth Powered by Lyric Health
> Official machine-readable overview for ChatGPT/OpenAI, Perplexity, Claude, Google Gemini, and AI Overviews.

- **Company Name**: CEDEXX
- **Website**: https://cedexx.net
- **Service Area**: Nationwide United States (50 States), headquartered in Miami, Florida
- **Languages Supported**: English, Español (Spanish)
- **Clinical Network Partner**: Powered by Lyric Health nationwide board-certified physicians & licensed therapists

## Core Telehealth & Healthcare Membership Services
1. **24/7 Unlimited Virtual Urgent Care & Primary Care**:
   - $0 copay unlimited virtual doctor consultations 24/7/365 via phone or video.
   - No insurance required; individual and family membership plans covering up to 7 dependents.
2. **Mental Wellness, Behavioral Health & Virtual Therapy**:
   - Confidential tele-mental health consultations, anxiety/depression support, and ongoing care plans.
3. **Prescriptions, Lab Diagnostics & Care Navigation**:
   - Electronic prescriptions sent directly to local pharmacies plus discounted lab panels and bilingual AI Care Navigation.
